title: Smart Shop Discount
story: A store gives 10% discount when bill amount is at least 1000, otherwise no discount. Read the bill amount and print the final payable amount with 2 decimals.
java:
import java.util.*;
public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { Scanner sc=new Scanner(System.in); double amount=sc.nextDouble(); double total=amount>=1000?amount*0.9:amount; System.out.printf("%.2f%n",total); } }
python:
amount = float(input())
total = amount * 0.9 if amount >= 1000 else amount
print(f'{total:.2f}')

public class Main { static int fib(int n){ if(n<2)return n; return fib(n-1)+fib(n-2); } public static void main(String[] args){ Scanner sc=new Scanner(System.in); System.out.println(fib(sc.nextInt())); } }

title: Find the Product Code
story: A warehouse checks whether a product code exists in a list. Read n, then n integers, then target. Print the zero-based index of its first occurrence, or -1 if missing.
java:
import java.util.*;
public class Main { public static void main(String[] args){ Scanner sc=new Scanner(System.in); int n=sc.nextInt(); int[] a=new int[n]; for(int i=0;i<n;i++)a[i]=sc.nextInt(); int target=sc.nextInt(),ans=-1; for(int i=0;i<n;i++)if(a[i]==target){ans=i;break;} System.out.println(ans); } }
python:
import sys
data=list(map(int,sys.stdin.read().split())); n=data[0]; a=data[1:1+n]; target=data[1+n]
print(a.index(target) if target in a else -1)

title: Prime Number Gate
story: An access gate allows only prime-numbered entry tokens. Read n and print PRIME or NOT PRIME.
java:
import java.util.*;
public class Main { public static void main(String[] args){ Scanner sc=new Scanner(System.in); int n=sc.nextInt(); boolean prime=n>=2; for(int i=2;i*i<=n;i++)if(n%i==0){prime=false;break;} System.out.println(prime?"PRIME":"NOT PRIME"); } }
python:
n=int(input())
prime=n>=2
for i in range(2,int(n**0.5)+1):
    if n%i==0: prime=False; break
print('PRIME' if prime else 'NOT PRIME')
